messages:
kevin: quick sync — can folks run the A100/H100/L40S latency/profile comparison I requested? I'm seeing weird p95->p99 delta on H100 that doesn't match kernel logs. Attached perf-bot output below shows a spike. Need confirmation before we open a regression PR. (run on commit 3f2b9d4)

sachin: which workload? the longctx chat model or small-gen? previous runs were mixed.

kevin: longctx (8k) + baseline batch sizes [1,2,4]. sequence distribution should match prod (512/1024/4096/8192). look at KV cache heatmap and nvlink band.

maria: I can kick off H100 tonight. which flags do you want? --warmup 200 --iters 1000? and upload to s3://redwood-perf/bench/1959998888/

kevin: yes warmup 200 iters 1000, set --latency-percentiles 50,90,95,99 and --trace-kernels. use commit 3f2b9d4. command:
```bash
./bench/run_bench.sh --model longctx-8k --devices h100 --batches 1,2,4 --seqs 512,1024,4096,8192 --warmup 200 --iters 1000 --out s3://redwood-perf/bench/1959998888/ --trace-kernels
```

perf-bot: automated report: H100 run (commit 3f2b9d4) completed. p50: 12ms, p95: 48ms, p99: 210ms, max: 1.9s. nvlink utilization 32%. KV cache hit 83%. logs -> https://redwood.internal/logs/3f2b9d4/h100

anna: want to align cost metric too — tokens/sec and cost-per-1M-tokens? we should include normalized unit-cost column in the table.

kevin: good point. include tokens/sec and estimate using current SKU prices (use table in /docs/pricing/skus.md). also compare quant-4 vs full fp16 variants.

tj: pinging @maria and @sachin for CR on bench harness PR #412 — added nvlink sampling and per-kernel timestamps. link: https://git.redwood/infer/bench/pull/412

maria: started H100 job 1959998899, will post results when done. also running A100+L40S after. -> I'll include raw profiles and a Jupyter notebook for visualization.

sachin: note: earlier A100 runs missed the small-batch microburst due to batching optimizer. please set ENV DISABLE_AUTO_BATCH=1 if you want raw latency.

kevin: good catch. add that env to the command.

maria: ack. adding DISABLE_AUTO_BATCH=1 now.

kevin: thanks team — if results show p99 > 150ms on H100 for batch=1, we'll triage kernel fallback path (cc @perf-bot). otherwise close as infra noise.
